author: Audree's Puppies
title: The New Pep AI Upgrade Is on a Whole Different Level!
content:
The latest Pep AI update has taken this app to a completely different level! The amount of detail, organization, and functionality they've added is seriously impressive. It's becoming an all-in-one platform for anyone looking to stay organized and track their peptide protocols, nutrition, and overall fitness journey.

Peptide Tracking & Protocols:
One of my favorite features is how easy it is to input your peptides, create personalized protocols, and set up dosing schedules. You simply enter your vial strength in milligrams (mg), how much bacteriostatic water you used for reconstitution, and your desired dose. The app automatically calculates the equivalent syringe units, making the conversion process incredibly convenient and eliminating the need to manually do the math. This is especially helpful when managing multiple peptides with different concentrations.

Nutrition Tracking & Preset Meals:
The improvements to the nutrition section are another huge plus! Being able to input and track nutrients, along with the addition of new preset meals, makes monitoring your daily intake much more convenient. It helps bring nutrition and peptide tracking together in one place.

Community & Groups:
Another great addition is the ability to join groups and connect with others. Having a community where people can share experiences, discuss their journeys, and learn from one another adds an entirely new dimension to the app.

One Feature I'd Love to See Next  Fitbod Integration!
As someone who regularly uses Fitbod to track workouts, one feature I would absolutely love is the ability to synchronize my Fitbod workout data directly into Pep AI. Imagine having your peptide tracking, dosing schedules, nutrition, strength training, and workout progress all connected in one place! Integration through Apple Health, Health Connect, or direct Fitbod syncing would make this app even more powerful.

Overall:

The developers have clearly put a tremendous amount of thought into this upgrade. It's not just about adding features; it's about making everything easier to track, more organized, and more accessible.

I'm genuinely impressed with how far Pep AI has come, and I'm excited to see what comes next. If they continue improving at this pace and expand their fitness integrations, this could easily become one of the most comprehensive tracking apps in this space.

Excellent update, Pep AI team! Keep raising the bar!

author: Nosurf2day
title: Good Concept, but the Developers Have More Work to Do
content:
The app has potential, but the dosing functionality needs work before I would pay for a subscription.

I tested three medications. With tirzepatide, I could select mg, mcg, or units and track my dose the way I actually administer it. With retatrutide, the units option appeared, but the app would not allow me to select it. I could only use mg or mcg. With HCG, units were not offered at all. The only choices were mg or mcg, which makes no sense for HCG. HCG is normally dosed in IU.

This is especially frustrating because the app already accounts for reconstitution. I know the concentration and how many syringe units I administer based on how I reconstituted the vial. Just let me record the actual number of units I take.

If an app is specifically designed to track peptides and related medications, its dosing options need to match the medications it supports. At a minimum, it should allow appropriate selections for mg, mcg, IU, and syringe units rather than restricting users to units that may not even apply to that medication.

Everything else I saw looked good, but this is core functionality. With only a three-day free trial before requiring a subscription, I’m not paying for an app that can accurately track one medication but not the others. I deleted it.

Fix the dosing options and I’d consider trying it again.
developer_response: Thanks for the thorough feedback here; this is super helpful for our team. We definitely want you to be able to have these unit options for your doses, and we can see how the current setup makes things harder to track. If you'd like, we will gladly email you when these options are added. Just email us at support@pepaipp.com and we'll follow up when it's done.
